target_customer: Individual resellers and casual sellers listing secondhand goods on marketplaces
problem: Creating listings across multiple marketplaces is slow and manual.
business_model: consumer/prosumer app (subscription implied, not confirmed) plus own marketplace

founders.name: Jeff Mao
previous_startups: Anti-bot reverse-engineering company sold to resellers (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Started as high-school sneaker reseller building software to buy limited releases.

founders.name: Tyler Ma
prior_employers: UGA industrial robotics (telemetry and control software)
education: Georgia Tech (one year, left) per YC profile; launch post differs

technical_complexity.rationale: Image recognition, pricing and cross-posting via marketplace integrations; mostly integration work using existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace integrations and LLM listing generation are copyable; eBay and others also add AI listing tools (not researched).

market_need_then: YC launch post claims 200,000+ signups and ~30% month-over-month growth; site claims 600,000+ sellers and 4.8 App Store rating (company claims).

identity.visual_style: Product-led dashboard screenshots; design not described by a source.
identity.voice_and_tone: Energetic, direct, benefit-focused short claims (company site).

branding.community_and_virality: Has a Discord community and mobile and desktop apps (company site).

brand_strength.rationale: No source on brand strength found; not rated.

outcome_analysis: SellRaze (Fall 2025, Active) shows fast self-reported user growth for a seven-person team, but no priced funding or independent traction source was found. It is early; platform dependency on marketplace access is a plausible risk but is not evidenced.
notes: The web search budget was exhausted before the required outcome, funding cross-check, dated-competitor and branding searches could run, so competition_at_founding is empty and brand fields rest only on the YC page and the company site. Tyler Ma education conflicts between YC profile and launch post. Traction numbers are company claims and differ between pages (200,000 signups vs 600,000 sellers).
